description: This file contains shell functions for platform-specific upgrade operations in an OpenWrt build environment, including checks for image metadata, image upgrade procedures, and configuration copying for specific hardware. It is tailored for gateworks, imx8m-based boards.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Checks the board name and enables image metadata verification if it matches certain patterns.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current board supports Sysupgrade; prints a message and returns failure if not supported.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the image upgrade process by writing the image to the appropriate device for specific hardware.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the appropriate partition on specific hardware.
